mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at overcast skies today with a temperature of 74 degrees at Badger Ridge Middle School.

Verona is prioritizing community wellness this September with Hunger Action Month and Suicide Prevention Month proclamations, while motorists should prepare for flagging on Highway M on August 31 and September 1.
There is plenty to do, including the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at various local venues, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon tomorrow, and Yoga at Insight Wellness on August 31.
In a report from the Verona Police Department, officers arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road on August 17 following a request from the Department of Corrections.
Enjoy the refreshing Mint Explosion flavor of the day at Culver's today, with the store remaining open for your convenience until 10:30 PM.
